001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack;
002
003import android.os.Bundle;
004import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
005import androidx.navigation.NavDirections;
006import java.lang.IllegalArgumentException;
007import java.lang.Object;
008import java.lang.Override;
009import java.lang.String;
010import java.lang.SuppressWarnings;
011import java.util.HashMap;
012
013public class NavGraphDirections {
014  private NavGraphDirections() {
015  }
016
017  @NonNull
018  public static OpenExplanationFragment openExplanationFragment(
019      @NonNull String[] permissionsToExplain) {
020    return new OpenExplanationFragment(permissionsToExplain);
021  }
022
023  public static class OpenExplanationFragment implements NavDirections {
024    private final HashMap arguments = new HashMap();
025
026    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
027    private OpenExplanationFragment(@NonNull String[] permissionsToExplain) {
028      if (permissionsToExplain == null) {
029        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Argument \"permissions_to_explain\" is marked as non-null but was passed a null value.");
030      }
031      this.arguments.put("permissions_to_explain", permissionsToExplain);
032    }
033
034    @NonNull
035    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
036    public OpenExplanationFragment setPermissionsToExplain(@NonNull String[] permissionsToExplain) {
037      if (permissionsToExplain == null) {
038        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Argument \"permissions_to_explain\" is marked as non-null but was passed a null value.");
039      }
040      this.arguments.put("permissions_to_explain", permissionsToExplain);
041      return this;
042    }
043
044    @Override
045    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
046    @NonNull
047    public Bundle getArguments() {
048      Bundle __result = new Bundle();
049      if (arguments.containsKey("permissions_to_explain")) {
050        String[] permissionsToExplain = (String[]) arguments.get("permissions_to_explain");
051        __result.putStringArray("permissions_to_explain", permissionsToExplain);
052      }
053      return __result;
054    }
055
056    @Override
057    public int getActionId() {
058      return R.id.open_explanation_fragment;
059    }
060
061    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
062    @NonNull
063    public String[] getPermissionsToExplain() {
064      return (String[]) arguments.get("permissions_to_explain");
065    }
066
067    @Override
068    public boolean equals(Object object) {
069      if (this == object) {
070          return true;
071      }
072      if (object == null || getClass() != object.getClass()) {
073          return false;
074      }
075      OpenExplanationFragment that = (OpenExplanationFragment) object;
076      if (arguments.containsKey("permissions_to_explain") != that.arguments.containsKey("permissions_to_explain")) {
077        return false;
078      }
079      if (getPermissionsToExplain() != null ? !getPermissionsToExplain().equals(that.getPermissionsToExplain()) : that.getPermissionsToExplain() != null) {
080        return false;
081      }
082      if (getActionId() != that.getActionId()) {
083        return false;
084      }
085      return true;
086    }
087
088    @Override
089    public int hashCode() {
090      int result = 1;
091      result = 31 * result + java.util.Arrays.hashCode(getPermissionsToExplain());
092      result = 31 * result + getActionId();
093      return result;
094    }
095
096    @Override
097    public String toString() {
098      return "OpenExplanationFragment(actionId=" + getActionId() + "){"
099          + "permissionsToExplain=" + getPermissionsToExplain()
100          + "}";
101    }
102  }
103}
